trainingEnvironment: real BadugiGameController through JSONL Python bridge
initialCheckpoint: isolated 2000-hand v2 Standard training checkpoint; initialization only, not a promotion claim
referencePolicy: published D03 v2 Standard ONNX for bootstrap and imitation anchor
informationBoundary: Hero observation is constructed from public events and own cards by the v2 controller encoder. Profile names control only scripted opponent actions; no true profile label is passed to the encoder or teacher. A separate independent slot audit remains required before promotion.
diagnosticRule: Stop at 200 hands, inspect chip conservation, legal actions, FOLD/PAT, action/amount distributions and unseen-seed independent sessions against the published Standard. A 5k checkpoint is safety/diagnosis only and never auto-extends training.
legacyE12Rule: The old E12 synthetic thresholds and E11-parent experiments remain safety context but cannot be claimed passed by this v2 run; E11 weights and hidden-profile observations are not reused. If a comparable v2 E12 gate is defined later, freeze it before evaluation and retain its stop conditions.
promotionRule: No registry or public asset change until an independently frozen real-controller session evaluation beats the adopted Standard under the preregistered margin, including cash/MTT, 2/3/6 seats, unseen opponent structures, legal action/amount, browser model-use and eight-second fallback.
safety: S01 v2 remains stopped; the other nine Standard games remain gated until all D03 tiers complete.
